error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Midnight Alerts

data.enable_crash_reporting: Send crash reports to Midnight Security

data_description.enable_crash_reporting: Helps us catch bugs faster. Only the error type and message are sent - never your address, API key, or alert data.

data_description.exit_time: How long to count down after arming before the area is fully armed
data_description.entry_time: How long to count down after a sensor trips before the alarm actually triggers
data_description.trigger_time: How long the alarm stays triggered before automatically resetting

data.arm_on_close: New sensors: hold arming open until closed

data_description.arm_on_close: If a newly-attached sensor is still open when the exit delay ends, wait for it to close instead of arming with it open
data_description.delay_on: A newly-attached sensor must stay open this many seconds before it's treated as a real trip - filters a momentary blip. 0 disables debouncing

data_description.entities: Each of these must also be individually attached to the relevant area via that area's "Manage sensors" step
data_description.timeout: How many seconds apart member trips can be and still count together
data_description.event_count: How many members must trip within the window before it counts as one confirmed event

data_description.is_override_code: When arming with this code, open sensors are bypassed instead of blocking the arm

data_description.code: Leave blank to keep the current PIN unchanged
